calls.title: Growthbook <> Groupon - Pro Sync
calls.summary: Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook sales) and Michal Pekarcik (Groupon’s experimentation lead, who is leaving at month-end) discussed GrowthBook’s billing overhaul and Groupon’s underpayment for seats. They explored an enterprise plan (~$50k/year) with unlimited users and governance features like SSO and role-based access.
